label: Reciprocal regeneration as an operational candidate for active life
definition: State records two Bool occupancies of independently identified substrate-processing and boundary-production capacities. regenerate feed s produces fresh occupants of each role iff feed and both prior capacities are present. Reciprocal rule requires full occupancy to regenerate, complete removal to stay empty, and each one-capacity knockout to remove the other next output. Inputs describe selected local capacities and experimental interventions; no organism, numerical life-event identity, substantial unity or soul occurs in the criterion. This is an analyst active-maintenance candidate, not a definition of every biological life.
note: OPEN: biological adequacy, local producer identification, environmental/system boundary and dormant-life extension; all in docs/notes/life-restricted-composition-327.md.
